description:
An inbox fills up whether you look at it or not. Receipts, boarding passes, GitHub alerts, newsletters, sales, and the odd scam, all in one pile.

Mailbag empties it. Press Clear inbox. Machine mail goes into seven folders: Receipts, Travel, Dev, Newsletters, Social, Promotions and Junk. Mail from people goes to your archive. The inbox is empty.

In Gmail the folders are labels. In iCloud Mail they are real folders. File everything is the gentler button: it files the machine mail and leaves people in your inbox.

Nothing is deleted. Junk is only for mail that looks like a scam, and it gets a folder too. Delete is a separate button. The list is a preview first, and nothing moves until you tap.

It sorts twice. Plain rules go first. For machine mail they cannot place, the sender, subject and a short preview go to a language model on our server. Mail from people is never filed and never sent to the model. You can turn the model off and use rules only.

Unsubscribe sends the sender's own one-click request where they support it.

Connect Gmail or iCloud Mail, or try the demo inbox with sample mail and no account. Outlook is not supported yet.
promotionalText: Inbox zero, one button. Machine mail into seven folders, people to your archive. Nothing is deleted.
